name: Participatory Formal Scrutiny Phase Declaration
purpose: Declare the participatory scrutiny phase and establish reviewer-governance boundaries for adversarial theorem evaluation.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The participatory formal scrutiny phase permits the structured adversarial evaluation of theorem packages by independent interpretive agents without permitting claim escalation.
phase_definition.meta_goal: Determine whether recursive inseparability survives independent interpretive pressure.

governance_rules.rule: Reviewer authority is limited to identifying gaps, ambiguities, and counterexamples; it does not extend to proof certification or status promotion.
All review artifacts must preserve the mandatory non-separability statement regarding ⇔R.
Disagreements and unresolved ambiguities must be recorded as first-class structural outputs.
